name: Hyper-CVAD (alternating Course A / Course B) for adult ALL
histology: B-lineage or T-lineage acute lymphoblastic leukemia

biomarkers.note: Hyper-CVAD is a cytotoxic backbone and is not itself biomarker-restricted. BCR::ABL1 (Ph) status is tested because a TKI is added for Ph-positive disease (see heme-all-ph-positive-tki); CD20 is tested because rituximab is added to the backbone (R-hyper-CVAD) in CD20-positive disease. Harrison 22nd ed. line 120184 names Hyper-CVAD as the alternating eight-cycle intensive regimen; NCCN B-cell (guidelines/b-cell.txt) lines 5132/15692 describe HyperCVAD with alternating high-dose methotrexate/cytarabine and integrated intrathecal CNS prophylaxis, and R-hyperCVAD adding rituximab.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Course A component (hyperfractionated cyclophosphamide). Harrison 22nd ed. Fig 111-1 (lines 119994 to 120016) and line 120184, and NCCN B-cell (guidelines/b-cell.txt) line 5125, name cyclophosphamide as a Course A drug but do not print the mg/m2 dose, schedule, or number of fractions in these extracts. Dose, unit, basis, and days are VERIFY (not inferred). Mesna uroprotection is customary with fractionated cyclophosphamide - confirm against the institutional template.

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: Course A component. Per-dose cap of 2 mg is the standard ISMP/StewardMD vincristine safety ceiling (a per-dose maximum that can only reduce dose), corroborated in NCCN B-cell (guidelines/b-cell.txt line 15695); ISMP tall-man vinCRIStine, IV-only (fatal if intrathecal). The mg/m2 dose and days are not printed in the ALL extracts (Harrison Fig 111-1 line 120016 lists Vincristine as a Course A drug without a dose) - dose, unit, basis, and days are VERIFY.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: Course A anthracycline (DOXOrubicin). Harrison Fig 111-1 line 120016 lists Doxo as a Course A drug but prints no dose in this extract - dose, unit, basis, and days are VERIFY. Cumulative-lifetime cap (warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2) is the conventional doxorubicin cardiotoxicity safety threshold applied by StewardMD, not printed in this source - track cumulative anthracycline exposure.

drugs.name: Dexamethasone
drugs.notes: Course A glucocorticoid. Harrison Fig 111-1 line 120016 lists Dexa as a Course A drug; Harrison line 120175 notes dexamethasone is often preferred to prednisone in ALL because it penetrates the blood-brain barrier. No mg dose or schedule is printed for the Course A dexamethasone in this extract - dose, unit, basis, and days are VERIFY.

drugs.name: Methotrexate (high-dose, Course B)
drugs.notes: Course B high-dose methotrexate. Harrison line 120040 gives a general ALL-consolidation range for HD methotrexate of 1 to 1.5 g/m2 (up to 3 to 5 g/m2), not the Hyper-CVAD Course B dose specifically - dose, unit, basis, and days are VERIFY. MANDATORY leucovorin (folinic acid) rescue plus serial methotrexate-level monitoring and urine alkalinization/hydration; hold folate antagonists and nephrotoxins.

drugs.name: CYTARabine (high-dose, Course B)
drugs.notes: Course B high-dose cytarabine. Harrison line 120040 gives a general ALL-consolidation range for HD cytarabine of 4 to 12 doses at 1 to 3 g/m2, not the Hyper-CVAD Course B dose specifically - dose, unit, basis, and days are VERIFY. High-dose cytarabine requires cerebellar/neurologic checks before each dose and corticosteroid eye drops for conjunctivitis/keratitis prophylaxis; reduce for renal impairment and age.

drugs.name: Intrathecal CNS prophylaxis (methotrexate +/- cytarabine)
drugs.notes: MANDATORY CNS prophylaxis. Harrison lines 120134 to 120138 describe intrathecal therapy for ALL as methotrexate alone or combined with cytarabine, with or without a glucocorticoid, given by lumbar puncture; NCCN B-cell (guidelines/b-cell.txt) line 5132 notes the HyperCVAD regimen includes intrathecal therapy. Intrathecal doses are fixed (not BSA-based) and are not printed here - dose, unit, basis, and days are VERIFY. Intrathecal agents are cytarabine and methotrexate ONLY; vinCRIStine must NEVER be given intrathecally (fatal).

supportiveCare: tumor lysis syndrome prophylaxis (hydration, allopurinol or rasburicase, electrolyte monitoring) - ALL carries high TLS risk; Harrison line 120030 notes ALL pre-phase therapy allows safe tumor reduction to avoid tumor lysis syndrome
high emetic-risk multi-agent regimen - antiemetic prophylaxis per NCCN Antiemesis high-risk tier (agent/dose pending per-disease template)
conventionally high febrile-neutropenia risk - growth-factor support per NCCN Hematopoietic Growth Factors guideline (timing/dose pending per-disease template)
high-dose methotrexate (Course B): mandatory leucovorin rescue plus methotrexate-level monitoring, hydration, and urine alkalinization
high-dose cytarabine (Course B): neurologic (cerebellar) checks and prophylactic corticosteroid eye drops
mesna uroprotection with fractionated cyclophosphamide (Course A) - confirm against institutional template

monitoring: CBC with differential before each course and during marrow aplasia
renal function before high-dose methotrexate; serial methotrexate levels with leucovorin rescue
cardiac assessment (anthracycline) and cumulative doxorubicin tracking
neurologic (cerebellar) assessment before each high-dose cytarabine dose
tumor lysis labs (K, phosphate, calcium, uric acid, creatinine) during induction

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas extract (used here only for the HyperCVAD regimen structure and the 2 mg vincristine cap)
guideline.locator: guidelines/b-cell.txt lines 5125, 5132, 15692, 15695 (HyperCVAD alternating with high-dose methotrexate/cytarabine, integrated intrathecal CNS prophylaxis, R-hyperCVAD, vincristine capped at 2 mg)

provenanceNote: Textbook-grounded StewardMD draft for adult ALL. Regimen identity (alternating Course A cyclophosphamide/vinCRIStine/DOXOrubicin/dexamethasone with Course B high-dose methotrexate/cytarabine, integrated intrathecal CNS prophylaxis, eight cycles) is grounded in Harrison 22nd ed. Chapter 111 (Fig 111-1 and line 120184) and the NCCN B-cell extract. The alternating Course A/B per-drug mg/m2 doses, fractionation schedules, and cycle length are NOT printed in the available adult ALL extracts and are therefore left as VERIFY rather than inferred; the vincristine 2 mg per-dose cap and the anthracycline cumulative cap are applied as StewardMD safety rules. Cycles resolved to 8 per Harrison line 120184. NCCN per-disease template, StewardMD clinical (R1) review, and any hospital-implementation overlay approval are pending. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
